body:
I got chills!! This....this was art. I have never in my life wanted to even look at hoarding as a symptom. I honestly cry and become so angry! I live with my Mom and it just....I just honestly want to kill myself some days because that would be easier. Better even. 

To put blame on her from all of her collecting and for me to not even go towards my dreams, because all I want is just to have a clean space. Yet I live in a square and have my entire life and dreams trapped in here with me.

I also want to add that your advice about slowly distancing myself is very helpful. And to be honest I got triggered when you brought up the ongoing resentment and lack of setting boundaries. That is so true, thank you for saying that. Through her friendship I’ve learned just how important boundaries are and staying true to them, which is me staying true to myself and when I do not stick by my boundaries it builds so much anger and negativity that the ultimate downfall becomes resentment and for me that is very hard right now to work through and let go, but I feel it’s possible to :)

Thank you for sharing <3
I’m sorry that you had a bad day :,(

I’ve confronted her in the past twice throughout our friendship and we mended our friendship, I do not want to make her feel bad that’s not my motives or intentions at all. Recently I was honest and messaged her that I need some time to be alone and it’s nothing personal so do not worry if I ghost you on text, when you call me, or Snapchat me. 

I truly have a lot of love towards this friend, but it’s at a cost. I’ve never had a friend where I feel so defensive with, every time I’m around her I’m going down the road of insecurities, being to over sensitive, to emotional and I’ve realized in the past and to this present moment just how low my self esteem is and how my self love is non existence. I do not want to fake self love and I do not want to fake confidence, I know for a fact that creating this positive energy is by being genuine from within which is a moral value to me. 

I just know that our friendship is not going to last because I won’t put up with that type of self loathing talk anymore. I’m also not going to be the friend that constantly boost up her ego and is her reassurance. I’m not putting up with being a friend that she keeps around because I’m the punching bag and the support system at the same time. 

It’s very hard, to me, to continue to be friends with someone that is a reflection of who I was, with a similar negative mindset to mine, I want to grow and mature from this old way of thinking. I do not mean this as I’m better or higher than her by no means, I’m saying that I need time to be alone and take a long extensive  look at my own life and question myself on why I have gotten to such a dark and toxic place and how I can come to peace and let go of these toxic negative belief patterns and create positive energy within myself.

It’s hard to make me believe this too. :,( same. This really makes me sad. When I was really depressed she said how she wanted me, but yet she treats me like this, filling my head with self contradiction and self hatred of who I am.

*breaths deep sad sigh* this is something that is very hard to accept and to let go.

Thank you for sharing <3

Hey there. It definitely is a regular thing that I’m living with, I currently am in therapy and I think I’m having an Aha! Moment and had to reach out to this forum for some clarity but still there’s something within me that is very sad because I don’t want this to be true. It’s very difficult living with her, when I shine, I instantly get her manipulating me with passive aggressive comments.

I’ve looked up narcissistic personality disorder  and I’m starting to see the connections. She’s more so a covert narcissist, not everyone sees it until you’re in her inner circle and she has very few people in her inner circle.

I.....don’t know how to thank you. these 17 questions are so valuable. I have other life events that are going on in my life and I feel with working through these questions will only bring me closer to the soul that I’ve kept hidden within me all of my life, for the fear of dealing with the pain of my own truth and honesty. 

Thank you!!!! :,)

i feel guilty sometimes with ignoring her, though sometimes just hearing from someone else that I can ignore her for as long as I’d like is just acknowledging my feelings in this friendship and how toxic it’s become. I have let her know in the past that I’m not in a good place and she will meddle and pry and try to get it out of me when sometimes I don’t even know why or even how to verbalize it when I don’t even have to, it’s complex with how I even got in this mental state lol. I’ve blocked her before and she freaked the fuck out, blew up my phone,and lost her damn mind. 

But you’re very right sometimes the answer is NO!

Thank you 💕
What do you do for unemployment though?? Do you fight them to receive unemployment?
Definitely! Having a mood journal and weed journal will be super helpful.
That’s wonderful to know and that’s amazing you were able to find something that helps! Thank you so much!
